overview: Copie Past-e is a production-grade cross-listing SaaS for resellers built on the Internet Computer. It supports Facebook Marketplace, Mercari, eBay, Poshmark, Depop, and Etsy — letting users create a master listing once and autofill platform-specific forms via a Chrome extension. Features include NFID social login (Google + Internet Identity), Gemini OCR for photo-to-form population, Stripe subscription tiers, a mobile-adaptive UI, and a retro-cyberpunk terminal aesthetic.
features: Cross-listing to 6 marketplaces: Facebook, Mercari, eBay, Poshmark, Depop, Etsy
NFID universal login — Google Social Login and Internet Identity
Chrome extension autofill — injects draft data into marketplace forms with one click
Mobile-adaptive UI — clipboard and deep-link buttons replace inject buttons on phone
Intelligent header — pulsing extension status icon and session-first install toast
Gemini OCR — upload a photo to auto-fill the entire listing form
Subscription tiers — Time Walker, Time Traveler, Time Lord via Stripe
Admin panel — user management, analytics, backup/restore, extension version control
Upgrade-safe Motoko backend — stable variables and migration stubs prevent data loss
